title: badbunnybebefan.site: I taught my computer to count the words
note: YHLQMDLG as data: a lilac page, a cut-out photo of him with a yellow and mint sticker outline, and a stack of fanned white index cards, one per word he says most (pensando, soltera, bunny… cabrón: said 38 times, and the songs it appears on). The headline is the pattern to steal: I taught my computer to count the words on / YHLQMDLG by Bad Bunny, in typewriter face then a big serif with by in italic. Photo credits written small and rotated beside each picture (photo: spotify). Worth reusing: a sentence that admits how the site was made; numbers as the content; tilted handwritten-feel credits.
